visuals.caption_fil: Apat na ugnayan ang dumadaan sa BHW — hindi ito nagtatrabaho nang mag-isa.
visuals.caption_en: Four relationships run through the BHW — the role never works alone.
visuals.alt_text_fil: Hub-and-spoke na dayagram: sa gitna ang BHW, apat na linyang umuusbong patungo sa Komunidad, Midwife / RHU, Barangay Officials, at Kapwa BHW.
visuals.alt_text_en: Hub-and-spoke diagram: the BHW is at the center, with four lines radiating out to Community, Midwife / RHU, Barangay Officials, and Fellow BHWs.

visuals.caption_fil: Habang tumataas ang antas — barangay, lungsod, munisipyo — dumadami rin ang taong may kinalaman sa serbisyong pangkalusugan.
visuals.caption_en: As the level rises — barangay, city, municipality — the number of people connected to the health service grows too.
visuals.alt_text_fil: Stack na dayagram ng apat na antas: Barangay (Punong Barangay, Kagawad sa Kalusugan) sa itaas, Barangay Health Station (Midwife), Lungsod o Munisipyo (CHO/MHO, Public Health Nurse, HEPO), at Local Health Board (Mayor bilang chairperson) sa pinakababa.
visuals.alt_text_en: Stack diagram of four levels: Barangay (Punong Barangay, Kagawad sa Kalusugan) at top, Barangay Health Station (Midwife), City or Municipality (CHO/MHO, Public Health Nurse, HEPO), and Local Health Board (Mayor as chairperson) at the bottom.
